title: Read Weeks 1-9 of the official schedule, one week at a time
what_it_changes: Turns the reconstructed standings into a real 136-game log, which unblocks opponent-aware ratings and the backtest corpus.
options: A: read all nine weeks now. B: read them week by week as the season closes. C: skip prior weeks and start the log from Week 11.
cost_of_doing_nothing: G1 and G3 stay open; every model stays naive.

title: Probe all 32 club-hosted depth pages
what_it_changes: Settles whether route (a) for depth order is viable, which unblocks the replacement-depth feature and the deficiency matrix.
options: A: probe all 32 and record URL/date/format. B: probe a sample of 8 first. C: abandon route (a) and close the feature.
cost_of_doing_nothing: REQ-45 and REQ-06 stay blocked indefinitely.

title: Decide the price-data policy in writing
what_it_changes: Unblocks the price-snapshot store, origination and every residual column.
options: A: licensed commercial feed. B: manual capture under a documented agreement. C: no prices, publish originated lines only with no market column.
cost_of_doing_nothing: No residual, no CLV, no ROI, and the leaderboard can never open.

title: Move raw injury rows behind the private data layer
what_it_changes: Keeps the public site to derived analysis until the terms position is settled.
options: A: move raw rows out now. B: keep them and publish the terms position first. C: leave as is.
cost_of_doing_nothing: The public site may republish more than the terms permit.

title: Add a Wednesday/Thursday/Friday capture job
what_it_changes: Turns the injury report from a snapshot into a series, which is what the surprise signal needs.
options: A: three captures per week. B: two (Wednesday and Friday). C: leave one per week.
cost_of_doing_nothing: The delta signal cannot exist; only levels can be published.

title: Join designations to inactives across several seasons
what_it_changes: Scores designation reliability properly and decides whether the label becomes a feature.
options: A: two full seasons. B: the remainder of 2026 only. C: drop the feature.
cost_of_doing_nothing: The label stays unusable, or worse, gets used unmeasured.

title: Publish a power calculation beside every gate
what_it_changes: Replaces round gate numbers with the n actually needed to detect the smallest useful effect.
options: A: publish the calculation for all twelve gates. B: for the ranking gates only. C: keep the stated thresholds.
cost_of_doing_nothing: A strategy could pass a gate that has no power to detect anything.

title: Transcribe venue, roof and surface for every fixture
what_it_changes: Builds the fixture-context feature set and the stadium overlay join.
options: A: venue for all weeks, roof/surface where published. B: venue only. C: skip.
cost_of_doing_nothing: Totals and passing props stay exposed to stadium effects.

title: Automate the weekly 'what changed' diff
what_it_changes: Replaces the static capture with a diff column, which is what a reviewer actually reads.
options: A: diff on injuries, depth and standings. B: injuries only. C: leave static.

title: Add freshness monitoring and alerting to the capture store
what_it_changes: Fails loudly when a source changes shape or goes stale.
options: A: monitor all nine sources. B: monitor the injury and schedule pages. C: rely on CI.
cost_of_doing_nothing: A parser can silently drift and publish blanks.

title: Publish the ablation protocol before the first fit
what_it_changes: Pre-registers the with/without comparison so the injury effect is measured, not asserted.
options: A: publish the protocol now. B: publish it with the first fit. C: compare only the final models.
cost_of_doing_nothing: The injury effect risks being fitted to the result.

title: Keep the leaderboard empty until a strategy earns a row
what_it_changes: Prevents a backtest or a short lucky run from appearing as a record.
options: A: keep the current hard rule. B: allow a shadow division with no ranking. C: rank on whatever exists.
cost_of_doing_nothing: The ranking stops being evidence of skill.

title: Capture the bye panel every week and join it to availability
what_it_changes: Stops a bye club from being read as injury-free.
options: A: join weekly. B: note the byes in text. C: leave it.
cost_of_doing_nothing: Four clubs per week are silently misread as healthy.

title: Record the first prospective forecast before Week 11 kickoff
what_it_changes: Starts the only record that can ever clear G8.
options: A: freeze a model version and record Week 11. B: wait for the depth source. C: wait for prices.
cost_of_doing_nothing: The prospective record stays at zero and nothing can ever qualify.

title: Split the injury report table into club sub-tables on the site
what_it_changes: Makes a 347-row table readable without losing a row.
options: A: sub-tables per club with a rollup. B: keep one long table with a filter. C: leave it.
cost_of_doing_nothing: The single largest table is hard to review line by line.

title: Reconcile the abbreviation trap once, centrally
what_it_changes: nfl.com prints AZ on the injury and standings pages and ARI elsewhere; joins silently drop rows.
options: A: one alias map in the pack, asserted by a test. B: normalise per table. C: leave it.
cost_of_doing_nothing: Joins between injury data and schedule data drop Arizona.
